payload.title: Real-replay owner-fixed OmniSource fusion with V2/V3 shadows and observability-first adjudication
payload.work_clay: Treat CLAY_OMNISOURCE_LIVE_FUSION_RESEARCH_REENTRY_DIRECTIVE as PROJECT_OWNER_FIXED_GLOBAL_OPERATION_LAW and the active source-coverage/research-reentry architecture. Do not build a second fusion architecture. Evaluate current promoted routing against CLAY_LIVE_FUSION_MESH_V2_CANDIDATE as an unpromoted adaptive routing shadow and CLAY_LIVE_FUSION_RESEARCH_BACKPROP_V3_CANDIDATE only for non-duplicate supplemental fault mechanisms such as SourceCursor continuity/gap detection, stranded-delta and broken-feedback-loop detection, coherent crash/restart replay, and external-effect idempotency boundaries. Before any routing-performance adjudication, persist or reproducibly reconstruct per delta: OmniSourceObservation/source cursor identity, semantic epoch, KnowledgeDelta/FusionAssessment identity, pre-route BranchDependencyIndex projection hash or snapshot, declared causal predecessors, each policy RoutePlan, receiver delivery/reconstruction/use/local-or-research-effect closure, ResearchReentryReceipt/result re-entry, payload/digest bytes, latency/resource shadows, exact-vs-approximate-priority lane identity, and repair/rollback state. Then run matched sparse/local and dense/high-centrality cases plus duplicate, stale epoch, missing dependency edge, causal reorder, source dropout/gap and crash/restart faults. Post-hoc affected-branch labels are an oracle baseline only and never candidate recall evidence.
payload.reason_clay: Current stack epoch 20 owner-fixes OmniSource intake and mandatory research re-entry. A concurrent 16:27 work revision correctly rebased this replay on that law, while this fusion independently found a missing observability requirement: the 15:56 real fusion event exposes only post-hoc DELTA/NO_CHANGE branch outcomes, so it cannot score V2 route recall or route-cost error without the pre-route projection/RoutePlan/FusionReceipt chain. This revision preserves the owner-fixed architecture, V2/V3 candidate boundaries and adds only the non-duplicate evidence gate needed for valid adjudication.
payload.completion_clay: Replay report first verifies owner-fixed OmniSource representative source-class coverage and ingestion->FusionAssessment->ResearchReentryReceipt closure, contradiction/counterevidence retention, research->architecture/test/work feedback and recursive result re-entry. It then compares current promoted routing, V2 shadow routing and only non-duplicate V3 supplemental mechanisms using identical recorded pre-route state. Report exact repo/head/semantic-epoch hashes; pre-route dependency snapshot/hash; policy RoutePlans; adjudicated ground truth separated from policy predictions; receiver delivery/reconstruction/use/effect/reentry receipts; payload/digest bytes; route-cost prediction error; source-gap and stale-window metrics; false interrupt/miss counts; stranded-delta and broken-feedback-loop counts; exact-vs-shadow authority checks; crash/restart/idempotency receipts; CPU/RAM/I/O/network/token-context rows; and separate SUPPORTED/REFUTED/REVISE/NO_CHANGE verdicts. No V2/V3, BASE ClayCode, Frank or canonical promotion from post-hoc oracle relevance or shared-ancestry repetition.
